data.narrative:
UFORCE is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Oleg Rogynskyy (CEO) and Oleksiy Honcharuk (co-founder and board chair, former PM of Ukraine). The company has raised $50M to date against a reported valuation exceeding $1B, which appears inconsistent with the capital deployed. The valuation assessment draws from a comparative universe of 10 private peers and 2 public companies in the Defense & Security sector, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression methodology is not applicable here. The reported $1B+ post-money valuation, when stepped forward by a typical seed multiplier of 2.5x, implies $2.5B—more than 20 times the $50M raised—suggesting the baseline figure is unreliable. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M) yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered at $700M. This median rests on a single applicable method, introducing material uncertainty. Key sensitivities include stage-specific valuation momentum within frontier defense tech, the strength and relevance of the peer set across varying technology maturity levels, and macro conditions affecting venture-scale defense investment.
